name: @simworkbench/workbench-gateway
description: Fastify auth gateway that fronts the FastAPI workbench. Composes the secure_core route plugins (login, recovery, workspaces, capsules, runs, tools, operator) and proxies /api/{workspace_slug}/... to the loopback-bound Python backend with HMAC-signed forwarded headers. Phase 0.5 (2026-05-09).
